answer.rationale: A release went out 2 hours ago and write-path p99 latency is climbing 5x. The closest matching precedent (memory_b1) shows rollback cleared a prior error spike cleanly without customer impact. While memory_b4 (circuit breaker) is a viable second-best if the rollback is not the actual cause, the release coincidence is the highest-probability root cause. I cannot fit both rollback and circuit breaker in one window; rollback is the better first move because it addresses the most likely root cause and the precedent shows it can complete without losing writes. If latency persists after rollback, the next window enables circuit breakers on the payments dependency.
